issue_context.title: Bug: Files fails all admin oprations
issue_context.body:
### Description

It will give the prompt to use admin then if given it will still fail.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Copy a folder/file
2. Paste it into C:\Program Files
3. Give admin access on prompt
4. See copy failed

### Requirements

- Use admin when given

### Files Version

2.5.22.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.2134

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/12398301/debug.log)
comments: Thank you for reporting this issue, I can repro it in `main`.

review_comments: The trick is using CLSCTX_LOCAL_SERVER, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER does not seem to work, meh.
